items.title: 古驰2026年三大巨变：Demna首秀、降价40%、关店100家，是自救还是重生？
items.summary: Weibo FAQ-style explainer thread frames Gucci's 2026 as defined by three simultaneous shocks -- Demna's runway debut, bag/apparel discounts up to 40% in China, and roughly 100 global store closures -- and poses the open question of whether this is self-rescue or genuine rebirth; comment threads split between readers calling it overdue correction and others calling it proof the brand lost pricing power.

items.source: Sina Finance / k.sina.cn (via Weibo 古驰悄悄降价 thread)
items.title: 古驰大降价最高40%！奢侈品铁律被打破，谁该趁机入手？
items.summary: Sina finance explainer confirms Gucci handbags and ready-to-wear in China have been quietly cut up to 40% (e.g., Ophidia mini bucket bag down over 40%, Mercato small tote down about 27%), framing it as the first time Gucci has broken the luxury 'prices only rise' convention since entering China in 1996; article notes Bernstein's warning that discounting is hard to reverse and carries a 'discount-ification' brand risk.

items.title: 싱글벙글 명품 브랜드 구찌 근황
items.summary: Popular DC Inside real-time-best board post reposts SBS news coverage of Gucci's new 'Made in China' sneakers, captioned that revenue has been cut in half so the brand is cost-cutting by 'selling out to China'; top comments mock the brand's fall from grace and question whether the luxury premium still holds once origin prestige is gone.

items.title: 실적 부진 구찌 '메이드 인 차이나' 판매 시작…120만~130만원대 명품 신발에 무슨 일이
items.summary: Korean news report details Gucci's new China-made 'Drip' sneaker line priced around 1.2-1.3 million won, noting Gucci's roughly 50% revenue decline over three years prompted the shift; cites Berenberg analyst warning that moving production from Italy to China risks creating tension between product origin and the brand's effort to restore luxury image.

items.title: 구찌 스니커즈가 메이드 인 차이나?…럭셔리 공급망 공식 '흔들'
items.summary: Trade outlet piece argues Gucci's China-made sneaker move breaks an unwritten luxury-industry rule that origin equals brand image, contrasting it with Louis Vuitton's practice of keeping 'Made in Italy/France' labeling even when much production happens elsewhere; frames Gucci as uniquely transparent (and exposed) versus peers who preserve the origin-premium illusion.

items.source: Weibo (古驰国内国外价差 FAQ series)
items.title: 古驰国内国外价差到底多大？2026年9月降价后最高省40%，代购还有优势吗？
items.summary: Weibo consumer-advice thread calculates that after September's price cuts, mainland China Gucci prices now sometimes beat overseas/daigou prices by up to 40% on select items, prompting debate over whether personal shopping agents (代购) have lost their traditional price advantage; replies show genuine purchase-timing interest alongside skepticism that cuts will hold.

items.source: Weibo (古驰在奢侈品行业地位 FAQ series)
items.title: 古驰在奢侈品行业地位跌至第九？3个维度看懂它还能不能买
items.summary: Weibo explainer cites Gucci's brand value falling 24% to roughly $11.4 billion, dropping it from 6th to 9th among global luxury brands, with 2025 revenue down 22.5% -- the steepest fall among top-10 houses -- attributing the decline to over-reliance on 'aspirational' middle-class buyers versus Hermes' ultra-high-net-worth base; comments mix brand-value shock with 'still iconic' defenses.

items.title: 패션계의 이단아 뎀나 영입한 구찌, 어떻게 바뀌었을까
items.summary: Hankyung feature revisits one year of Demna at Gucci, crediting him with giving the brand a clearer design identity versus the De Sarno era but noting sales recovery has lagged creative buzz; piece treats the creative reset positively while flagging that commercial proof (store traffic, sell-through) is still pending.

items.source: Weibo (Gucci x F1 Alpine sponsorship / 度假购买 discussion)
items.title: 度假买古驰经典祖母绿，怕烂大街？古驰Racing／F1 Alpine赞助讨论串
items.summary: Weibo consumer-advice thread mixes mention of Gucci's upcoming F1 Alpine team sponsorship ('Gucci Racing,' starting 2027) with practical buyer advice on classic emerald-green Gucci styles while traveling; engagement is moderate and mostly transactional (purchase advice) rather than emotionally charged brand sentiment.
